prompt:
GAME BUTTON ICON. One small scene seen from the side, centred, as an icon on a command button in a top-down strategy game.

Image 1 and Image 2 are our approved button icons from the same game: match their outline weight, shading, palette and finish only, not their shapes.

Create an ORIGINAL icon meaning "link this vehicle to a mechanitor's command": a small olive truck seen from the side at the bottom, and above it a small hovering teal diamond-shaped command beacon glowing softly, with three bold unbroken teal signal arcs reaching down from the beacon to the truck's roof.

Style: an icon for the game RimWorld: a very thick near-black outline around every shape, bold simple shapes, flat cel shading with two or three tones per material, a muted palette with one bright accent at most, readable when shrunk to 64 pixels. Not a photograph, not a 3D render, not pixel art.

Draw ONLY the icon, alone on a plain pure white background, filling about three quarters of the canvas. Square canvas. No people, hands, text, letters, numbers, logos or brand marks.
